Class HeldEyeGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.HeldEyeGameTestsLogic
public final class HeldEyeGameTestsLogic extends Object
Coverage for a loose Googly Eye held in a hand. The server schedules its hurt and heal reactions from the real damage and heal hooks and reports them per hand; the client shows them on the same per-hand simulation that first- and third-person draws share, beside its deterministic ambient expressions. How the eye looks in the hand is verified in game.

  • Method Details

    • heldEyeBulgesWhenHurt

      public static void heldEyeBulgesWhenHurt(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template)
      A held eye bulges when its holder takes any damage, at the server's growOnHitPercent; here it is 100, and each hand's eye reacts on its own. In game: with growOnHitPercent = 100, hold a Googly Eye in each hand and take fall damage; both eyes bulge and settle back, in first person, in F5, and as another player sees them.

    • heldEyeHonorsServerSettings

      public static void heldEyeHonorsServerSettings(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template)
      The server's switches govern held reactions: with hit growth at 0 and heal swirl off, damage and healing start nothing. In game: set growOnHitPercent = 0 and swirlOnHeal = false in somegoogly-server.toml, hold a Googly Eye, take damage and eat a golden apple; the eye only idles.

    • heldEyePlaysIdleBehaviors

      public static void heldEyePlaysIdleBehaviors(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template)
      A held eye plays the server's ambient expressions from deterministic world-time slots, on one simulation per hand that stack copies keep. In game: hold a Googly Eye and stand still for up to 40 seconds, switching between first person and F5; it blinks, stares, or glances on the same pupil in both views.

    • heldEyeResetsWhenPutAway

      public static void heldEyeResetsWhenPutAway(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template)
      Putting the eye away retires its simulation and any received reaction; equipping it again starts afresh. In game: hold a Googly Eye while it bulges from a hit, switch to another item and back; it is at rest.

    • heldEyeSwirlsWhenHealed

      public static void heldEyeSwirlsWhenHealed(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template)
      A held eye swirls when its holder heals, then not again until the cooldown passes, and a heal while it is busy keeps the current reaction. In game: hold a Googly Eye, get hurt, and eat a golden apple; the eye swirls once, and further regeneration within ten seconds starts no second swirl.

    • heldEyeWinksAlone

      public static void heldEyeWinksAlone(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template)
      A lone eye's blink closes it, and cross-eye, which needs a partner eye, is never chosen. In game: hold a Googly Eye and watch it idle; it winks shut now and then but never crosses.
